confirmHarvest(uint256,uint256).details: Re-verifies token IDs (state may have changed since submit).       INV-4: creditPerToken capped at MAX_CREDIT_PER_TOKEN.       INV-5: auto-rejects if REQUEST_TTL exceeded.       NOTE: Does NOT call WhaleVault.validateAndRecordHarvest()       because that function is onlyDeltaVault. Multisig must call       WhaleVault directly to reconcile harvestCount if needed.

params.creditPerToken: Internal credit units per token (6 dec, capped)

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

submitHarvestRequest(uint256[],uint256,b.details: No ETH moves. Stored PENDING until multisig confirms.       Signed payload (off-chain bot):       keccak256("EWB_HARVEST_V1", harvester, keccak256(tokenIds[]),                 sigTimestamp, nonce)       Security order (INV-2):         1. Validate timestamp freshness         2. Rebuild and verify signature         3. Burn nonce (AFTER sig verified)         4. Verify token IDs in WhaleVault         5. Check for duplicate token IDs (INV-3)         6. Store request

params.nonce: Unique bytes32 — burned after verified use
params.sigTimestamp: Timestamp from signed payload (must be < 1hr old)
params.tokenIds: NFT token IDs — must all be locked in WhaleVault

confirmHarvest(uint256,uint256).notice: Confirm a pending harvest request and award internal credit.

getHarvesterRequestCount(address).notice: Total number of requests submitted by a harvester.         Use off-chain indexing of HarvestRequestSubmitted events         to retrieve individual request IDs.

harvestCredit(address).notice: Internal credit balances (6 dec, no ETH/USDC)

harvesterKey().notice: Off-chain bot key. Set once — INV-1.

setHarvesterKey(address).notice: Register the off-chain bot key. One-time — INV-1.

submitHarvestRequest(uint256[],uint256,b.notice: Submit a harvest request: token IDs + ECDSA proof.
